prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / view derivation. Create a FOUR-VIEW design sheet of the EXACT twin-drill tracked vehicle in the reference. Landscape ivory canvas, four equal clean panels in a 2 by 2 grid: FRONT upper-left, exact LEFT SIDE with nose/drill LEFT upper-right, TOP plan with both drills LEFT lower-left, REAR head-on lower-right. Orthographic-looking design drawing, no perspective hero angle. Preserve orange/ivory/graphite KINETIC_CEL linework and surface segmentation from the single master. No text, shadows from a scene, robot body or extra mode.

Roster and shape lock: TWO mirrored long modules side-by-side linked along one CENTER seam form ONE wide tracked vehicle; TWO forward-pointing short silver conical drills in thick orange/ivory cylindrical collars, one per module; each module has an elongated white polygonal upper shell with small sloped blue-black glazing, orange frame and rear armor return, black recessed grilles, and front/rear tracked running groups with visible dark wheels. Treads are continuous linked black belts wrapping around end wheels, with orange side guards and white polygonal wheel-side plates. Both halves and their drill bases, glazing, armor seams and track positions match. No third drill, extra cabin, robot limbs or arms. Preserve the thick orange rear raised belt guards visible in the reference rather than replacing the rear with a blank box.

FRONT: two equal silver drill noses symmetrically face the viewer, ground contacts aligned, two little blue glazing strips above, left/right modules separated by the central seam. SIDE: camera exactly perpendicular, near module side covers far module; one conical drill points left and the second overlaps it, elongated chassis and two tracked running groups align along a level ground line; do not show a second forward face or both module widths in this side view. TOP: two equal long modules and two drills aligned toward left, visible center split and coupling braces, track groups stay at their correct sides. REAR: show the same two raised orange rear guards and black tread returns, white/orange heel-end armor and recessed black grilles; no forward-pointing drill magically appearing behind. Match common total module length, track height and drill diameter between views. These are clear same-object view drawings, not four redesigns.
